was in the “C” semifinals where the T.H. Titans/Laurier Chevrolet Invasion defeated their club partner Trent Halls Saints/Whetung Lumber Rage 8-0.
In the “Hawks Pack It In Jamaica Bowl” sponsored by Smith Enterprises, Tyler Brownfie and Josh Pelover scored a pair of touchdowns to lead the “Stars and Stripes” South Shore Payday Titanintos to a 28-15 win over the “Black Sea” ICB Crude Masters. Brownfie and Saxon Talbot increased the score by adding a convert and an extra point, respectively.
Jourdan Wood and Chad Harris each scored two majors, but managed only an extra point in the loss. Mikey Schad completed both major’s, scoring the other point in the loss
